description: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana is a component of the Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals belonging to minority communities by providing financial assistance for establishing and operating new business ventures. It supports economic empowerment through financial aid and entrepreneurship training.
objectives: Promote entrepreneurship among minority communities in Bihar.
Generate self-employment opportunities for eligible youth.
Provide financial assistance for setting up new business enterprises.
Enhance entrepreneurial skills through mandatory training programmes.
Promote economic growth and financial inclusion.

benefits.title: Financial Assistance
benefits.description: Financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000 is provided for establishing a business.

benefits.title: Non-Repayable Grant
benefits.description: Up to ₹5,00,000 (50% of the project cost) is provided as a non-repayable grant.

benefits.title: Interest-Free Loan
benefits.description: The remaining amount up to ₹5,00,000 is provided as an interest-free loan. Under specific sub-schemes, a nominal interest rate of 1% may apply.

benefits.title: Entrepreneurship Training
benefits.description: Mandatory skill development and entrepreneurship training is provided to beneficiaries.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Community
eligibility.description: The applicant must belong to a recognized Minority community.

eligibility.title: Educational Qualification
eligibility.description: The applicant must have passed at least 10+2 (Intermediate), ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or an equivalent qualification.

eligibility.title: Age Limit
eligibility.description: The applicant must be between 18 and 50 years of age.

eligibility.title: Business Type
eligibility.description: The proposed business must be established as a proprietorship or partnership firm.

registration_steps.title: Visit Official Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the official Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana portal and click on 'Registration/Log in'. Select 'Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (MMUY)'.

registration_steps.title: Create Account
registration_steps.description: Enter your Aadhaar number and create a password.

registration_steps.title: Login
registration_steps.description: Log in using the Aadhaar number and password.

registration_steps.title: Complete Registration
registration_steps.description: Fill in the registration form with the required details.

application_steps.title: Login to Dashboard
application_steps.description: Log in to the portal using your Aadhaar number and password.

application_steps.title: Fill Application Form
application_steps.description: Complete the application form with all required information.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Upload all the prescribed supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Review Application
application_steps.description: Verify all information before final submission.

application_steps.title: Download Acknowledgement
application_steps.description: Download and print the acknowledgement receipt for future reference.

documents_required.name: Matriculation Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Should contain the applicant's date of birth.

documents_required.name: Intermediate / Equivalent Passing Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or equivalent qualification certificate.

documents_required.name: Minority Community Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Proof that the applicant belongs to a minority community.

documents_required.name: Permanent Residence Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Proof of permanent residence in Bihar.

documents_required.name: Applicant's Signature
documents_required.remarks: Scanned signature in the prescribed format.

important_notes: Women belonging to minority communities may choose either the Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana or the Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana.
Entrepreneurship training is mandatory for selected beneficiaries.

Applicants under this scheme cannot simultaneously apply for Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Yojana, Mukhyamantri Anusoochit Jati/Anusoochit Janajaati Udyami Yojana, or Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana.
The proposed business must operate as a proprietorship or partnership firm.

faqs.question: How much financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligible applicants can receive financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000.

faqs.question: How is the financial assistance structured?
faqs.answer: Up to ₹5,00,000 is provided as a non-repayable grant and up to ₹5,00,000 is provided as an interest-free loan.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Permanent residents of Bihar belonging to minority communities, aged between 18 and 50 years, who meet the prescribed educational qualifications.

faqs.question: Is entrepreneurship training compulsory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected beneficiaries are required to undergo mandatory entrepreneurship training.

faqs.question: Can an applicant apply under multiple Udyami schemes?
faqs.answer: No. Applicants under this scheme are not eligible to apply simultaneously under the other specified Mukhyamantri Udyami schemes.
